stage0060_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$田中司令$$
「He escaped $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$,
　and his whereabouts since are unknown」

stage0060_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$敷島$$
「Now that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army has struck in earnest,
　we must ready ourselves to meet them head-on」

stage0060_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$敷島$$
「$$正太郎$$... $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ have been
　overhauled, every ability powered up.
　I'm counting on you」

stage0060_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$正太郎$$, if you can't fight...」

stage0060_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm fine, $$ミサト$$.
　If $$グーラ$$ won't change his mind,
　then I'll fight for Earth's peace」

stage0060_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「$$金田正太郎$$...!
　You who play at being Prince $$グーラ$$'s friend,
　I, $$ダンカン$$, will strike you down!」

stage0060_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$正太郎$$
（$$グーラ$$...!
　I'm a member of $c, protector of Earth!）

stage0060_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$正太郎$$
（If you're targeting Earth,
　I won't hesitate to fight!）

stage0060_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「As expected of $c, Earth's strongest!
　You really did it!」

stage0060_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Looks like you're struggling, $$ダンカン$$」

stage0060_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Oh, Prince $$グーラ$$.
　You've returned」

stage0060_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Bring out my $$スペースロボ$$.
　I'll bury $$鉄人$$ and $c with my own hands」

stage0060_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That $$スペースロボ$$!
　It's $$グーラ$$'s!」

stage0060_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$グーラ$$
「My thanks for wasting a precious day.
　I'll crush you all with my own hands」

stage0060_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Earthlings.
　Still you continue this futile resistance?」

stage0060_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$葵$$
「Ugh... he's sent another copy of himself!」

stage0060_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$シモン$$
「No need to fear something like that!
　Let's do this, everyone!」

stage0060_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Earthlings.
　You do not understand my power」

stage0060_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「A parting gift for $$グーラ$$.
　Let me show you a taste of my power」

stage0060_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$弁慶$$
「That $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ guy summoned it!?」

stage0060_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$キタン$$
「Don't screw with us!
　Calling a monster like that into the city!」

stage0060_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$インベーダー#keyword$$s destroy everything in sight!
　Hurry, or Tokyo becomes a city of the dead!」

stage0060_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$,
　that hungry destroyer will heed your commands.
　Use it, and strike them down」

stage0060_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Call off the $$インベーダー#keyword$$, $$グーラ$$!
　Do you mean to destroy Tokyo!?」

stage0060_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Remember, $$グーラ$$!
　The time we spent together!」

stage0060_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You treasured it too, didn't you?
　That's why you came to see me!」

stage0060_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$グーラ$$
「All of that is in the past」

stage0060_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$... if you truly mean to fight...」

stage0060_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Stop it, $$正太郎$$!
　What good is lying to your own heart too!」

stage0060_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$オックス$$...
　You don't want to fight $$グーラ$$ either, do you...」

stage0060_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's right, $$正太郎$$!
　If you and $$グーラ$$ both keep lying
　to your hearts, nothing will change!」

stage0060_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「You don't want to fight $$グーラ$$, right!?
　Then stick to it!」

stage0060_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit carrying everything on your own,
　kid, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0060_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$葵$$
「You're not the only warrior protecting Earth」

stage0060_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$n
「Your strong sense of duty is admirable.
　But let us shoulder some of it too」

stage0060_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$赤木$$
「We'll handle the fight against them!
　You just be friends with that selfish prince!」

stage0060_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$シモン$$
「And once you do it, give it everything!」

stage0060_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　I'll never give up!
　I'll make you stop fighting, no matter what!」

stage0060_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$グーラ$$
「A whole day, and you still haven't learned
　that it's useless!」

stage0060_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Here's the thing, $$グーラ$$!
　You can fail a hundred times,
　as long as the last try succeeds!」

stage0060_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$正太郎$$!
　Let's make this that last try!」

stage0060_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Now then... since we talked big to $$正太郎$$,
　we'll clean up the rest of them ourselves」

stage0060_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「My blood's already up for it」

stage0060_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$シモン$$
「We push on through!
　No matter what stands in our way!」

stage0060_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$タケル$$
「You're the one who'll save $$グーラ$$!!」

stage0060_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「How about that, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　No matter what tricks you pull,
　we will never lose!!」

stage0060_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Still, to suddenly teleport an
　$$インベーダー#keyword$$ to Earth like that...」

stage0060_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$隼人$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...
　A being fundamentally unlike any foe we've fought」

stage0060_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「So you've come to grasp a bit of my power」

stage0060_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But you have grown too powerful.
　Leaving bearers of the $$烙印$$ unchecked
　serves me no advantage either」

stage0060_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$田中司令$$
「This is bad...!
　Even I can tell this is trouble!」

stage0060_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Dimension boundary warping at his position, confirmed!」

stage0060_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「No!
　He means to spawn a black hole right here on Earth!」

stage0060_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「There's no way something like that's possible...!」

stage0060_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$タケル$$
「That $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ claims to be a black hole's
　avatar! At this rate, Tokyo will...!」

stage0060_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$隼人$$
「This isn't on that level!
　The entire Earth will be swallowed!」

stage0060_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're saying today's Earth's last day!?」

stage0060_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's right, Earthlings.
　Savor the taste of your own powerlessness」

stage0060_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Taste the despair I felt
　twelve thousand years ago」

stage0060_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Please wait, Father!
　I will conquer Earth myself, I swear it!
　Please leave Earth's fate to me!」

stage0060_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I beg you, Father!
　Give me this chance!」

stage0060_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$... can you truly win this by yourself?」

stage0060_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I will prove it!
　So please, hold back a little longer!」

stage0060_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Very well.
　If you insist so strongly, then just this once,
　I'll leave it to you」

stage0060_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「You heard my resolve, $$正太郎$$!
　Next time, I will surely defeat you all
　and make Earth my own!」

stage0060_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Wait for that day to come!」

stage0060_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$n
「But this is no different from being shown mercy by the enemy!」

stage0060_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$タケル$$
「Do you truly want to defeat us
　with your own hands...? Or...」

stage0060_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Tell me, $$グーラ$$...
　Is fighting really our only choice...」

stage0060_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop fighting, $$グーラ$$!
　I don't want to fight you!」

stage0060_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Still spouting nonsense like that!?
　Just give it up already!」

stage0060_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Or are you afraid to fight me?」

stage0060_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$グーラ$$
「If you're not scared, then fight!
　That is my wish!」

stage0060_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't give up over one failure, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0060_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't give up hope!
　Keep trying until it reaches him!」

stage0060_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　I won't give up!
　I'll keep calling to you till you stop fighting!」

stage0060_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Why, $$正太郎$$...
　Why do you go so far...」

stage0060_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Isn't it obvious!
　Because you're my friend!」

stage0060_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If today wasn't enough to show you
　there's more fun than fighting, we'll
　keep at it as many days as it takes!」

stage0060_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$正太郎$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ may be your father,
　but that's no reason you have to
　invade Earth!」

stage0060_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Silence, $$正太郎$$!
　Don't mock Father!」

stage0060_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I won't listen to you anymore!
　I'll defeat you here for confusing me!」

stage0060_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Then, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll take away your power to fight!」

stage0060_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「My apologies, Prince $$グーラ$$!
　Demon General $$ダンカン$$ falls back!」

stage0060_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「How dare you, Earthlings!
　You'll pay for the shame you brought
　upon $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$'s name!」

stage0060_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$!
　You and I are fated to fight!」

stage0060_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$... why won't you understand...」

stage0060_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$グーラ$$
「How dare you, Earthlings!
　You'll pay for the shame you brought
　upon $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$'s name!」

stage0060_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「You'd best prepare for that day!」

stage0060_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...
　We won't lose...!」

stage0060_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If you're after Earth, then I'll...」

stage0060_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Come, $$正太郎$$!
　Show me the power of your $$鉄人$$!」

stage0060_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　Are you really saying you'll fight!」

stage0060_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$グーラ$$
「No words are needed between us!
　There is only battle!」

stage0060_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Is that really true, $$グーラ$$!
　You look like you're hesitating to me!」

stage0060_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If you won't stop fighting,
　I'll take your power to fight away!」

stage0060_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Enough already, $$グーラ$$!
　There's so much fun stuff in the world,
　why do you want to fight so badly!」

stage0060_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Because that is the mission given to me!」

stage0060_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Just quit it already!
　Without fighting, we could be friends!」

stage0060_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Nonsense!
　I'll take care of you before $$正太郎$$!」

stage0060_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$甲児$$
「How about it!
　Taste my Rust Hurricane Croquettes!」

stage0060_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I haven't eaten anything like that.」

stage0060_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Now I get why you won't stop fighting!
　Eat my croquettes and fighting will
　seem downright stupid!」

stage0060_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$グーラ$$
「What a simpleton.
　You think a reason like that would stop a war?」

stage0060_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up, $$グーラ$$!
　Croquettes aside, if you trample on
　$$正太郎$$'s feelings, I won't forgive you!」

stage0060_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Brat!
　If all you do is follow daddy's orders,
　I won't go easy on you either!」

stage0060_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Mocking my mission is the same
　as mocking my father, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0060_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So what!
　A brat throwing his weight around
　under daddy, I'll knock you both out!」

stage0060_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$葵$$
「Not interested in my beauty?
　You're quite the stiff, Prince $$グーラ$$」

stage0060_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Before my mission,
　such things are worthless」

stage0060_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$葵$$
「Aren't you a bold one!
　Seems this stiff boy needs some discipline!」

stage0060_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$タケル$$
「Stop, $$グーラ$$!
　Keep fighting like this and not just $$正太郎$$,
　you'll be unhappy too!」

stage0060_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Is that a premonition from your psychic powers?」

stage0060_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's not it!
　I'm saying it's dangerous to fight while hesitant!」

stage0060_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$グーラ$$
「How rude, to pry into someone's heart!
　Do you want to make $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$
　angry that badly!」

stage0060_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$グーラ$$...!
　If you insist on fighting,
　I'll face you in $$正太郎$$'s place!」

stage0060_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$タケル$$
「I won't let sorrow spread through space any more!」

stage0060_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$赤木$$
「Stop, $$グーラ$$!
　So many people live in Tokyo!」

stage0060_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$グーラ$$
「So what?
　Earth will be mine eventually.
　The lives living there are mine too」

stage0060_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$赤木$$
「Are you serious right now!
　Don't you know right from wrong!」

stage0060_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$赤木$$
「I knew it, you shouldn't be fighting!
　Before things become irreversible,
　I'll stop you!」

stage0060_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「A foolish question.
　It's the mission Father gave me」

stage0060_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's strange to do whatever
　your parent tells you, no matter what!
　You're you!」

stage0060_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$シモン$$
「Bring it on!
　If you won't stop fighting, I'll be your opponent!」

stage0060_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Just what I wanted.
　I'll deal with you before $$正太郎$$」

stage0060_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't underestimate me!
　A brat who just struts around doing
　daddy's bidding can't beat me!」

stage0060_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$シモン$$
「Grit your teeth!
　For trampling on $$正太郎$$'s kindness,
　you're gonna feel some pain!」

stage0060_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Why won't you listen to a friend!?
　Don't you have any friends!?」

stage0060_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Friends...?
　I have no need for such things」

stage0060_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Not even knowing what a friend is...」

stage0060_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can't let a kid like that fight!
　I'll be the one to stop you!」

stage0060_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$グーラ$$
「You have no right to order me」

stage0060_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$n
「Just get out!
　Get out and face $$正太郎$$!」

stage0060_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$n
「If you still insist on fighting,
　then I'll be the one to face you!」

stage0060_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Heh... meddling like this,
　do you think it's charity work?」

stage0060_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$n
「That's not it, $$グーラ$$!
　It's because I pity you for not knowing a friend's worth!」

stage0060_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$n
「$$グーラ$$!
　If you won't listen to me,
　I'll drag you out of the cockpit by force!」

stage0060_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「$$金田正太郎$$!
　You'll pay for confusing Prince $$グーラ$$!」

stage0060_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So it's you making $$グーラ$$ fight!」

stage0060_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't forgive you!
　I'll beat you and make $$グーラ$$ stop fighting!」

stage0060_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Just like the Doctor said!
　$$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$'s power is rising!」

stage0060_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$! $$オックス$$!
　Together, we'll protect Tokyo!!」
